paper.title_en: Exactly solvable Brill waves: explicit gravitational-wave initial data with trapped surfaces
paper.abstract_en: Vacuum initial data for pure gravitational waves on $\mathbb{R}^3$ (Brill waves) have so far been obtained only numerically. Here a one-parameter family is solved exactly: in toroidal coordinates the constraint separates, and a suitable seed function makes every mode equation hypergeometric. The data are real analytic and asymptotically flat and exist precisely for $k<k_c=0.8048\ldots$; their mass is an explicit series with a pole at $k_c$. Near $k_c$ the data provably contain trapped surfaces and an apparent horizon. A scaling symmetry yields further solvable families, one of them elementary.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在纯引力波初值问题（Brill波）上给出首个精确可解的单参数族，明确构造了含囚禁面和视界的渐近平坦实解析数据，并给出质量级数在临界值处的极点；对广义相对论基础与初值问题研究者具有明确的点击阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 精确可解的Brill波：含囚禁面的显式引力波初始数据
decision.abstract_zh: $\mathbb{R}^3$ 上纯引力波的真空初始数据（Brill波）迄今只能通过数值方法获得。本文精确求解了一个单参数族：在环面坐标下约束方程可分离，且适当的种子函数使每个模方程都成为超几何方程。这些数据是实解析且渐近平坦的，且恰好当 $k<k_c=0.8048\ldots$ 时存在；其质量是一个显式级数，在 $k_c$ 处有极点。在 $k_c$ 附近，可以证明这些数据包含囚禁面和一个视界。一个标度对称性给出了更多可解族，其中一个是初等的。
